propositions: The undecomposed axis fires on 0.107% of plan-v3 verified findings (11/10,250) and 0.153% of plan-v4 (18/11,773), two orders of magnitude below all other axes.
The stated G5 deterministic suppressor veto fired zero times across 2,000 recorded reviews despite being cited as the explanation for the low fire rate.
The undecomposed hard-override floor (0.85) is not gated on grade, causing all non-none grades including low to produce the same impact floor; 25 of 29 fires had no other override active.

The inverse population of findings matching flat-plan regex patterns but scored as none is dominated by regex false positives on code/module decomposition rather than missed plan-decomposition defects.
The 90%+ of reviewed tickets are childless, making the proposed G5 suppression mechanism inapplicable to the population it was cited to explain.
The axis's low rate and floor miscalibration pattern matches previously fixed issues in ac_unverifiable and divergent_implementation axes, indicating a tuning defect rather than detection absence.
